title: Computer Modeling of Complex Systems
weeklyTopics: Building and analyzing a personal ABM project
skills: critical reading of complex systems research
designing and analyzing a research project
scientific writing (project proposal and final project)
workloadNotes: Netlogo and Python exercise sets, a project brainstorm/lit review, in-class brainstorm, a project proposal (20%), and a final project (35%) - final project is the capstone deliverable.
prerequisitesText: No formal Complex Systems prerequisite; beginner-level programming and basic statistics/math strongly encouraged.
textbooks: Introduction to the Modeling and Analysis of Complex Systems (Hiroki Sayama)
An Introduction to Agent-Based Modeling (Wilensky & Rand)
